name: hcapp_getRunsAtStart
description: The kennel's other runs at the same local date and time (to the minute) as a run about to be saved (E3.F1.S8). The app asks before saving a new run or a changed start and confirms 'Another run at this time?' when anything comes back. Rule: HC6.RunsAtLocalStart, shared with hcportal_getRunsAtStart. Missing input or a caller without createEditRuns gets an empty answer, never an error.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The run's kennel. NULL = empty answer.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run being saved (the id the app minted for a new one); never matches itself. NULL or the empty GUID excludes nothing.

parameters.name: startDatetime
parameters.description: The start exactly as hcapp_addEditEvent will receive it; its local wall clock (offset ignored) is compared to EventStartLocal, to the minute. NULL = empty answer.

rowsets.description: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) only: the error detail alone, no envelope. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

rowsets.name: RunsAtStart
rowsets.description: adHocData: one row per other run of the kennel at that local start; absent or empty = no clash.

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: The run's name (FbEventName when the run uses imported details).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
